mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (a sympathomimetic stimulant) increases cardiovascular stress and metabolic demand, which may exacerbate thyroid dysfunction and complicate management of hyperthyroidism treated with propylthiouracil.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and thyroid function closely; consider alternative ADHD treatment if possible, and ensure propylthiouracil dosing is optimized to control hyperthyroidism before stimulant use.
